name: AthosZone
description: AthosApp is a comprehensive companion application designed for navigating and exploring the Mount Athos region. Built entirely with .NET MAUI, it provides an all-in-one toolkit for visitors, featuring interactive map navigation (powered by Mapsui), real-time weather integration, and up-to-date ferry and bus schedules. The app utilizes SignalR and Firebase notifications for a live presence declaration system, keeping users connected and informed throughout their journey.
author: Kiriakos Mourouzidis
